pages.title: Sustainability at SIEM - Siem Shipping
pages.main_text_excerpt:
Committed to Cleaner Oceans, Skies, and Supply Chains
At SIEM Shipping, sustainability is more than an ambition. It is a responsibility embedded in how we operate.
From vessel design and fleet performance to everyday operational decisions, we are committed to reducing emissions, improving efficiency and protecting the environments and communities connected to our activities.
Our Approach to Sustainability
Shipping plays a vital role in global trade, and we recognise our responsibility to operate as efficiently and responsibly as possible.
Our approach combines modern vessels, cleaner fuels, smarter operations and continuous investment in technology. By making sustainability part of our long term decision making, we aim to improve environmental performance while continuing to provide safe, reliable and efficient maritime transportation.
Cleaner Fuels and Efficient Vessels
We continue to explore and adopt solutions that can reduce the environmental impact of our fleet.
This includes the use of cleaner and alternative fuels, energy efficient vessel designs and technical improvements that help reduce fuel consumption and emissions. Each investment is considered with a long term perspective, supporting both operational efficiency and the transition towards more sustainable shipping.
Smarter Fleet Operations
Sustainability is shaped not only by how vessels are built, but also by how they are operated.
Through careful voyage planning, performance monitoring and collaboration between our teams on shore and at sea, we continually look for opportunities to improve efficiency, optimise fuel consumption and reduce unnecessary emissions.
Our objective is clear: to minimise harmful emissions into the sea and atmosphere through the use of cleaner fuels, smarter fleet operations, continuous investment in vessels and new technologies, responsible environmental management and collaboration across our business and industry.
Sustainability at SIEM Shipping is a long term commitment built on innovation, accountability and action. As technology advances and industry expectations evolve, we will continue working to improve our performance and contribute to a more sustainable future for maritime transport.

pages.title: Who we are - Siem Shipping
pages.main_text_excerpt:
SIEM Shipping is your trusted partner for specialised shipping, using comprehensive expertise to connect industries and communities with innovative, customer-centric approach.
From car carriers to reefers and offshore vessels, we combine an expansive fleet with global reach and diverse operations. With owned vessels, leasing, ship management and logistics all in the same place, we become a source of holistic, connected expertise.
These insights enable us to deliver consistently, design highly tailored solutions, drive progress in niche markets, and shape the future of global shipping
 
  
  
	
Crucially, we put our customers first in everything we do. It’s there in the way we prioritise partnerships and open collaboration, taking the time to understand your ambitions on a deep level – then deliver with agility and precision. And it’s there in the way we strive for better, more efficient operations, leading our industry with the adoption of clean, responsible fuels that drive down emissions.
Working with SIEM Shipping is working with a team that’s leading the shipping sector by example – and can lead you to success through our innovation and operational excellence
